ref_entities: create a subclass of ImplicitFunctionBase that implements the forward method for a custom implicit function
implement the forward method on an ImplicitFunctionBase subclass to process ray bundles with optional camera and global code
check if an implicit function subclass allows multiple passes by calling the allows_multiple_passes static method
check if an implicit function requires pooling without aggregation by calling the requires_pooling_without_aggregation static method
override the on_bind_args method in an ImplicitFunctionBase subclass to handle custom argument binding during the forward pass
create an ElementwiseDecoder to scale, shift, and apply relu or sigmoid activation to feature tensors
build an MLPWithInputSkips NeRF-style MLP with configurable skip connections and xavier weight initialization
create an MLPDecoder that wraps MLPWithInputSkips to decode spatial embeddings into output features
build a TransformerWithInputSkips module with pool and ray attention layers for 3D scene decoding
review the TransformerEncoderLayer class implementing self-attention and feedforward with configurable model dimensions
build an IdrFeatureField MLP with custom hidden layer dims and geometric initialization for 3D implicit rendering
create an IdrFeatureField with harmonic embedding functions for encoding 3D point coordinates before the MLP
run a forward pass through IdrFeatureField with a ray bundle to get signed distance and feature values
review the IdrFeatureField geometric_init weight initialization strategy for the last layer and skip connections
test the IdrFeatureField forward pass with view pooling and global code conditioning inputs
build a NeuralRadianceFieldImplicitFunction MLP-based NeRF model with configurable harmonic embeddings and input skip connections
build a NeRFormerImplicitFunction transformer-based NeRF model with dimension reduction and pooling support
review the NeuralRadianceFieldBase forward method to understand ray sampling, density prediction, and color computation
refactor the _construct_xyz_encoder method to swap between MLP and transformer architectures for 3D point encoding
summarize the _get_colors method which normalizes ray directions and computes per-point RGB colors via the color layer
build an SRNRaymarchFunction module to compute raymarch features from a ray bundle using harmonic embeddings
create an SRNPixelGenerator module to predict raw densities and RGB colors from raymarch features and ray directions
run an SRNRaymarchHyperNet to generate a cached raymarch function from a global code via a hypernetwork
test the SRNImplicitFunction forward pass to compute raymarch features or pixel colors from a ray bundle
review the SRNHyperNetImplicitFunction class to understand hypernetwork-based implicit scene representation with cached raymarch functions
create embeddings for 3D implicit function rendering from world coordinates with optional viewpooling and global code
interpolate 3D volume grid values at arbitrary points using trilinear interpolation via grid_sample
bilinearly interpolate 2D plane grid values at arbitrary points using grid_sample
linearly interpolate 1D line grid values at arbitrary points using grid_sample
broadcast and concatenate a global code tensor to the last dimension of embedding tensors
create a FullResolutionVoxelGrid with configurable resolution changes and trilinear interpolation for 3D feature lookup
create a CPFactorizedVoxelGrid using CANDECOMP PARAFAC factorization with three vector components for memory efficient 3D grids
create a VMFactorizedVoxelGrid using Vector Matrix factorization with three matrices and three vectors from TensoRF
create a VoxelGridModule wrapper that holds voxel grid parameters as trainable PyTorch parameters or registered buffers
change the resolution of voxel grid values at specific training epochs using linear or bicubic interpolation
build a VoxelGridImplicitFunction with voxel grids, harmonic embeddings, and MLP decoders for density and color estimation
run the forward pass on a ray bundle to compute per-point densities and colors using the voxel grid implicit function
create a low-resolution scaffold occupancy grid to filter empty-space points and accelerate ray marching
crop the density and color voxel grids to the object bounding box found in the scaffold at a given epoch
review how create_decoder_density_impl and create_decoder_color_impl auto-calculate input dimensions from voxel grid and harmonic embedding outputs
